title: Εἰς τὸν Πλάτωνος Φαῖδρον σχόλια — Hermias, Commentary on Plato's Phaedrus (RU «Схолии к „Федру“»)
author: Hermias of Alexandria (recording Syrianus' lectures)
edition: Couvreur 1901, public domain: https://archive.org/details/hermiaealexandr00couvgoog. Lucarini and Moreschini, Teubner 2012 (standard, copyrighted).
ru_evidence: ruwiki Гермий Александрийский lists no translation. CyberLeninka ('Гермий Федр перевод') and ΣΧΟΛΗ issues show only studies.
en_evidence: Baltzly and Share, Hermias: On Plato Phaedrus 227A–245E (Bloomsbury 2018), 245E–257C, and 257C–279C (2025), per Open Library.
other_translations: German: Bernard (1997), not verified in this sweep. French and Italian: unknown.
value: The only complete surviving Neoplatonic commentary on the Phaedrus, from Syrianus' school. Central for Neoplatonic theories of eros, divine madness, the soul-chariot, rhetoric and inspiration, and for the Renaissance reception (Ficino).
ai_feasibility: High. Lemma-based scholastic prose with repetitive terminology, and the English version for cross-checking. Care is needed with Neoplatonic divine hierarchies.
pilot_unit: Commentary on the palinode myth, Phdr. 246a–249d, about 15k words (estimate).
